Thanks for flagging, Ava. This is a known edge case when Calendly falls back to the server locale rather than the browser locale — especially for APAC customers using older browsers or corporate SSO. Two fast options: 

1) Manual ICS pinned to Asia/Seoul (KST) — reliable. I’ll attach one and you can send it directly.
2) Quick booking fallback — offer an explicit slot bank ("I’m available Feb 11 10:00 KST / Feb 10 18:00 PST / Feb 11 01:00 UTC") and ask them to click confirm; then send a manual invite regardless of Calendly.

Longer term: Ops can update the embed to include the timezone selector and add a small copy note for APAC/EU. I’ll log a HubSpot task for Product to check the widget config.

Attaching: manual-invite.ics (UTC timestamps but TZID=Asia/Seoul included).
